official_sources.title: Food Safety and Standards (Packaging) Regulations, 2018
official_sources.issuing_body: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Govt. of India
key_sections: Regulation 3: General Requirements (Sub-clause 4 explicitly bans newspaper use)
Regulation 4: Specific Requirements for Primary Food Packaging
Schedule I & II: Lists of prescribed BIS standards for paper, plastics, glass, and metal
Schedule III & IV: Migration testing protocols and overall migration limits (60 mg/kg)

official_sources.title: Food Safety and Standards (Labelling and Display) Regulations, 2020
key_sections: Mandatory FSSAI logo and 14-digit license number display
Date marking: 'Date of manufacture' and 'Expiry date' / 'Use by'

official_sources.title: Food and Drug Administration (FDA) Maharashtra Official Portal
official_sources.mandate: Enforcement of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, state sampling, anti-adulteration drives, licensing and inspections across Maharashtra districts.

official_sources.title: IS 9845:2020 — Method of Analysis for the Determination of Overall Migration of Constituents of Plastics Materials
official_sources.scope: Prescribes analytical methods using distilled water, 3% acetic acid, ethanol, and rectified olive oil/iso-octane at specified temperatures to verify non-toxicity of food packaging.

official_sources.title: IS 6615: Paper for Packaging and Wrapping — Specification
official_sources.scope: Specifications for food-contact paper, grease resistance, bursting strength, and permissible toxic substance thresholds.
